items.name: Red Dot Sight
items.description: A battery-powered optic. Tighter groups and a little more reach. Fit it at the weapon station.

items.name: Long Range Scope
items.description: A magnified scope. Great reach and accuracy, but slower to bring on target.

items.name: Suppressor
items.description: Soaks up the kick of every shot, at a small cost in stopping power.

items.name: Compensator
items.description: Vents gas upward to keep the muzzle down. Calmer and tighter.

items.name: Long Barrel
items.description: More damage and reach, but it kicks harder.

items.name: Foregrip
items.description: A second hand on the gun steadies every shot.

items.name: Angled Grip
items.description: Faster, smoother reloads and a slightly quicker trigger.
